command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin --prune; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git reset --hard origin/work/plug-screen-automation-entry-20260917; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0463af650bd647ebe300b7ec161323fda58e7520"; echo '=== PHONE ALPHA INSTALL ==='; pnpm android:phone-alpha; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$(command -v adb || true)"; if [ -z "$ADB" ] && [ -x "$SDK/platform-tools/adb" ]; then ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; fi; test -n "$ADB"; echo '=== DEVICE ==='; echo "manufacturer=$($ADB shell getprop ro.product.manufacturer | tr -d '\r')"; echo "model=$($ADB shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; echo "android=$($ADB shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')"; echo "sdk=$($ADB shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')"; echo '=== PACKAGE ==='; $ADB shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName=|versionCode=' | head -4 || true; sleep 8; PID="$($ADB shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$PID"; echo "pid=$PID"; echo '=== RESUMED ACTIVITY ==='; $ADB shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true; echo '=== UI HIERARCHY ==='; $ADB shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/lcl-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; $ADB shell cat /sdcard/lcl-window.xml 2>/dev/null | head -c 24000 || true; echo; $ADB shell rm -f /sdcard/lcl-window.xml || true; echo '=== APP LOGCAT FILTER ==='; $ADB logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -E 'AndroidRuntime|FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in|link.localclimate.app|Capacitor|chromium.*(ERROR|CONSOLE)|console' | tail -n 500 || true; echo '=== FATAL CHECK ==='; if $ADB logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR in link.localclimate.app'; then echo 'FATAL_OR_ANR_DETECTED'; exit 31; else echo 'NO_FATAL_OR_ANR'; fi; echo '=== REPO CLEAN ==='; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git rev-parse HEAD
